story.fullStory:
Neil Diamond's "You Got To Me" reached #18 on the Billboard Hot 100. "You Don't Bring Me Flowers" is a song written by Neil Diamond with Alan and Marilyn Bergman for the daily TV sitcom All That Glitters.

The song was intended to be the theme song, but Norman Lear, the show's creator, changed the concept of the show and the song was no longer appropriate.

Diamond then expanded the track from 45 seconds to 3:17, adding instrumental sections and an additional verse.

The song peaked at #18 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 8 weeks on the chart.
